title: Wave Machine Demo
full_prompt: Create a 3D visualization of a torsion wave machine using ManimGL. First, define a custom 3D Group class called `WaveMachine` that constructs a central shaft (using a Cylinder capped with Circles) and a series of radial arms (using Cylinders with Sphere caps) distributed evenly along the shaft's length. Each arm should be rotated by a progressively increasing angle (controlled by `delta_angle`) to form a helical pattern. In the main scene `WaveMachineDemo` (which should inherit from both `InteractiveScene` and `ThreeDScene`), instantiate this wave machine. Position the camera in a perspective view and animate the creation of the machine's arms using a lagged creation animation. Then, rotate the entire machine continuously around its longitudinal axis to demonstrate wave propagation. Next, smoothly transform the machine's arms into a higher-density configuration (smaller delta angle) using a curved path transformation (`path_arc`), and rotate it again. Finally, perform one more transformation to an even denser configuration and rotate it to show a highly smooth wave motion.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incompatibility between ManimGL's self.frame and Manim Community's self.camera
common_failure_modes.note: The reference code uses ManimGL's InteractiveScene frame manipulation (e.g., frame.reorient). In Manim Community, this must be translated to camera orientation methods.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing Cylinder or Sphere 3D primitives in older Manim versions
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the rendering environment supports 3D Cylinder and Sphere mobjects.
The transformation of arms uses path_arc and path_arc_axis=RIGHT to ensure they rotate cleanly around the shaft during morphing. Incorrect axis will cause arms to distort.
